_doc: GLOBAL asset index — every still/clip we produce, rich metadata for cross-piece reuse. Redo'd assets are DELETED from disk and DE-INDEXED, never kept here.

assets.title: Father, forgive them (close)
assets.subject: intimate close of the crucified Christ's face, eyes lifted to heaven in prayer, sorrow and mercy together, a shaft of light across His features
assets.doctrine: the red-letter prayer 'Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do'

assets.title: The cross over us
assets.subject: the cross from a low angle against a breaking storm sky, Christ high upon it, the upright planted firmly in the rocky hilltop; one ordinary figure kneels at the foot, a shaft of light between them
assets.doctrine: the sin that put Him there was ours too; the One who prayed for His killers still lives to intercede

assets.title: The risen Christ — mercy held out (HERO)
assets.subject: the risen Christ in warm golden morning light, clean flowing robes, glorified face at peace, one open hand with a round healed scar reaching toward the viewer in welcome
assets.doctrine: 'While we were yet sinners, Christ died for us' — the gospel invitation to receive it by faith (Rom 5:8)

assets.title: Our sin — the shadow of the cross
assets.subject: the long dark shadow of the cross falls over a group of ordinary ancient figures with bowed heads
assets.doctrine: the sin that put him there was ours too

assets.title: Gospel wide — risen Christ in the doorway
assets.subject: the risen Christ standing in a light-flooded doorway, arms open in welcome, feet planted
assets.doctrine: while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us (Rom 5:8)

assets.title: The living Christ interceding
assets.subject: the living risen Christ standing in warm light, both scarred hands lifted in intercession
assets.doctrine: the Lord who prayed for his executioners still lives to make intercession (Heb 7:25)

assets.title: Wide at the foot of the cross: the whole crucified figure above, Roman soldiers crouched below casting lots — establishes THAT this is a crucifixion.
assets.subject: Wide at the foot of the cross: the whole crucified figure above, Roman soldiers crouched below casting lots — establishes THAT this is a crucifixion.
assets.prompt: inked biblical graphic-novel wide of a crucifixion on a bleak hill: the full crucified man on a tall wooden cross, head bowed, arms nailed along the beam, and at the foot two or three 1st-century Roman soldiers crouched in the dust casting a few pale rounded pebbles over a folded woven garment, one dominant grouping, bold black ink, flat cel-shaded ochre and iron-grey, reverent, dark storm sky, period-accurate

assets.title: A shadowed crowd mocking — shaking heads, shot-out lips — the scorn a curse was expected to answer.
assets.subject: A shadowed crowd mocking — shaking heads, shot-out lips — the scorn a curse was expected to answer.
assets.prompt: inked biblical graphic-novel of a 1st-century crowd mocking, with only THREE distinct foreground mockers, each a clearly DIFFERENT person — a grizzled grey-bearded old elder, a younger clean-shaven man, and a heavy middle-aged man with a dark beard — jeering upward with open scornful mouths and pointing hands, in dusty earth-toned head-wraps and coarse tunics; behind them the rest of the crowd is a DARK FEATURELESS SILHOUETTE MASS with no individual faces, bold black ink, flat cel-shaded dusk palette, reverent tone despite the scorn, tension

assets.subject: Christ's face and shoulders on the cross, arms along the crossbeam, lips just parting to speak instead of curse.

assets.title: David the psalmist's hand over an ancient scroll, foretelling the parted garments a thousand years early.
assets.subject: David the psalmist's hand over an ancient scroll, foretelling the parted garments a thousand years early.
assets.prompt: inked biblical graphic-novel of an aged hand of an ancient Hebrew psalmist resting on a half-unrolled scroll seen at a steep raking side-angle so the parchment is strongly foreshortened and its writing reads only as faint indistinct rhythmic horizontal ink strokes with no separate letters and no alphabet; a young white lamb lying quietly in FRONT of the scroll as the clear focal subject (the foreshadowed sacrifice), a small clay oil lamp casting warm amber light, one dominant subject, bold black ink of the SAME line-weight and reverence as the Golgotha scenes, flat cel-shaded amber lamplight, reverent, 1st-millennium-BC

assets.title: A soldier lifts the seamless robe as the lots fall — the prophecy fulfilled in real time.
assets.subject: A soldier lifts the seamless robe as the lots fall — the prophecy fulfilled in real time.
assets.prompt: inked biblical graphic-novel of a seamless woven robe held up in one Roman soldier's hand while two or three clearly-thrown pale lots land in the dust below, the gambling read unmistakable through the soldiers' intent crouch, one dominant subject, bold black ink, flat cel-shaded ochre and grey, reverent, low angle, 1st-century

assets.subject: A single executioner mid-deed — hand still on the mallet — hard-faced and unknowing: the guilty sinner he intercedes FOR.

assets.subject: Christ on the cross, head bowed in willing surrender under real strain — no one takes his life from him.

assets.title: The risen Christ as the great high priest / Mediator — profile, wounded hands lifted toward the light of heaven, pleading, a small shadowed sinner kneeling below whom he intercedes for.
assets.subject: The risen Christ as the great high priest / Mediator — profile, wounded hands lifted toward the light of heaven, pleading, a small shadowed sinner kneeling below whom he intercedes for.
macro_elements: print of the nail in the palm
assets.prompt: inked biblical graphic-novel of the risen Christ as the great high priest interceding at the throne of heaven: standing in three-quarter view, both open hands lifted upward, the centre of each open palm marked by a single old HEALED scar — a thin dark closed mark lying flush and flat within the skin in the same warm skin tone, long-healed; fingers relaxed with plain natural fingertips, his bearded face lifted in earnest pleading toward a high radiant heavenly light above (the light only, no figure in it), and low behind him a single small shadowed kneeling sinner he stands between and pleads for, Christ the one dominant subject, flowing robe, bold black ink, flat cel-shaded warm gold and deep shadow, hard-edged light shaft from above, reverent, cinematic, 1st-century

assets.subject: The land under three hours of darkness and the temple veil torn from top to bottom — his death opens the way.
